title: The Rose King and the Demon King

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed, just as Flash-senpai recommended,
this establishment has a delightful
atmosphere...)

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, valued customer,
but I am terribly sorry.
We are currently fully seated at the
moment...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Then I shall take my leave and return another
time.

Kukuku...
It is far too early to withdraw,
Young Lord of the Rose.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My Round Table remains empty...
Shouldst thou possess the resolve to cross
blades with me
—step forth.

text_block_list.name: Café Master
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems they are saying,
"Please join us,
if you don't mind sharing a table."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............I see.
I am deeply grateful for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'Our coffee is our pride,' is it...?
They appear to have black tea on offer as well,
but..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Dost thou waver, fledgling...?
Then let me reveal it to you—
the 'Third Option.'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Master, serve this patron
the 'Crimson and Ebony Nuptials'!
Put the tab on my account!

text_block_list.name: Café Master
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, one yuenyeung tea.
Right away.

text_block_list.name: Café Master
text_block_list.text:
This is a blend of coffee and black tea,
a well-known beverage in Hong Kong...
Fufu, I hope it suits your palate.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This is... yes, exceptionally delicious.
—This is a wonderful establishment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After a short while—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The master of this establishment is an
'alchemist of gastronomy.'
Potent enough to entice even me...
into partaking of the forbidden fruit.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, this is... exquisite.
To bake an apple with such delicate
finesse...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To think 'baked apple' was such a delicate
dish...
...I must revise my understanding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A little while later—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To think he was the true culprit...
I didn't suspect a thing until the very
end.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, the astonishing spectacle spun by that
creator has not yet reached its finale—
in the chapters to follow,
an even greater shock awaits thee!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—And that is how it went.
I ended up borrowing the sequel as well...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have seldom indulged in books of this nature,
yet it is surprisingly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finding it unusual for Rose Kingdom to be
reading a
book in that field, I inquired about it,
only to learn of an
unexpected encounter and the days of connection
that followed.
choice_data_list: To think you two had that kind of ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have sought guidance from Gimlet-senpai
on many matters ever since that day.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Which is to say,
the 'true intent' behind this diversion
beckoning phantoms toward the dawn lies
precisely there...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Um, Gimlet-senpai...
I have been meaning to ask you for some time
now...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, your distinctive manner of speech—
upon what manner of background is it
founded?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To my embarrassment,
my own understanding often falls short of
discerning their true intent...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Fuhahaha! And small wonder!!
For I—
I am the Demon King!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A Demon King who shatters the royal road to
tread the demonic path paved by his own
aesthetic—
how then could the verses I weave ever be
confined within the cages of a
dictionary?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spot Rose Kingdom in the library.
Seeing her diligently jotting down notes,
I approach to offer help if it's for her
studies, when—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...The abyss.
The bell tolled by nightmares echoes
with the cheers of its kin...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the notebook revealed words
like
'Demon King, Pitch-Black, Abyss, Corruption,
God of Destruction'— In short,
the entire page was crammed with thoroughly
menacing terminology.
choice_data_list: L-Lady Rose? What on earth are you...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. This is, you see...
so that I may decipher the Demon King's
words.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet-senpai provided an explanation for
me.
As to the very wellspring from which her
words flow—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yet, pathetic as it is—
I couldn't even understand half of it...
choice_data_list: So such things can happen as well?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wish to understand more.
I want to be someone who truly knows the
words she weaves...
choice_data_list: You really don't need to go to suc...
My king will be swallowed by the a...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Interacting with others can bring varied
influences.
While it can broaden one's world,
at other times—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore,
knowing how overly earnest she is,
I also harbored concerns that she might end
up immersing herself
far too deeply into the world of the "Demon
King."
choice_data_list: I don't think that's the kind of t...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even I understand that her diction is akin
to poetry—
something sheer erudition can do little to
decipher.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However... I wish to understand.
Even just a little.
The 'words' she shares with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swayed by my king's dead-serious expression,
I ended up
accompanying her in search of literature
that might shed light
upon this so-called 'Demon King.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Swallowed... by the abyss—?
That's it...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Those words just now... somehow sound
reminiscent of Gimlet-senpai's phrasing...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Surely,
that sensibility is the crux of it...
What must I study to attain it? Please,
tell me...!
choice_data_list: Well, uh, it just kind of slipped ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Rose Kingdom,
ever the earnest student,
bombarded me with questions until I was
utterly exhausted...
